st: Phones that pollute like cars and chickens more efficient than cows

sec.t: ff.32.1 How much do phones pollute?
ff.32.2 Let's drink to that (or maybe not)
sec.p: Among the trends analysed in the book, Vaclav also dwells on wine consumption.

60% of food goes to feeding animals (in North America). Meat's climate impact is well known. Another interesting number is the one just mentioned, on the impact of feed production. But not all animals are equally efficient at converting feed into protein.

sec.t: ff.32.4 Vaccines beat the stock market
sec.p: Vaccines are the best investment there is. At least the pentavalent vaccine, which is good practice to give every newborn before 12 months, at a cost of about €1.
